name: dsh-glass-mood-theme
description: Glassmorphism theme for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI whose material follows agent activity (pearl white idle, steel blue working): per-state MP4/WebM wallpapers behind one visibility knob, glass panels with per-panel opacity/blur/highlight and sticky surface detection, high-contrast label tiers, opaque content surfaces, and frosting reserved for page-like dialogs.
